name: Scene Derivatives for Evolving Surfaces
aliases: Reynolds transport relation for evolving surfaces
Transport Relation for Differentiating Surface Integrals
definition: A motion X is a class C3 function defined on reference configuration B × R, where for any fixed parameter π, X(·, π) is a deformation mapping B to a regular surface M(π) ⊂ R3.
summary: Scene Derivatives for Evolving Surfaces is a mathematical framework for differentiating integrals over implicit surfaces that distinguishes itself by providing a parameterization-independent normal scene derivative.
